subject: Re: CISC kickoff — cheaper self-consistency for reasoning endpoints
body:
Priya,

Staffing:

- Katya 50% Mar–Apr: paper reproduction on prod models, owns the eval methodology.
- Umar 40% throughout: confidence-extraction methods (the within-question confidence evaluation from the paper is the part I trust least to transfer, he'll pressure-test it).
- Nikhil 30% Apr: offline A/B harness on logged traffic.
- Jorge Vidal is committed at 60% to this project for May 2026 — he owns the serving-path integration with Zeke's Shipyard team, and I've blocked his calendar accordingly. Shadow deployment can't slip, so I wanted a named owner with real allocation, not spare cycles.

Compute: sampling-heavy but inference-only. Requesting 64 A100s best-effort on Titan for March/April evals; serving-side capacity comes from Shipyard's existing pool.

Deshawn
